series.name: EHB named messages (battery hybrid GW5000/6500/8600/0010-EHB)
series.notes: Documented models GW5000-EHB, GW6500-EHB, GW8600-EHB, GW0010-EHB. EHB is a high-voltage battery hybrid, not listed on the Pakistan product page, so it is a lower PK priority than ES Uniq / SDT G3 / ET. Its named table is close to the ES/SBP one but adds 'PV Over Voltage', 'AC HCT Check Failure', 'AFCI Fault' and 'GFCI Device Check Failure' as explicit rows and adds a numbered FAQ section (8.2) for behaviour questions. Codes here are message strings only.

title.ur: AFCI Fault (EHB) - arc fault module ne arc pakda

meaning.en: The arc fault module either failed its self-test or detected an arc at the inverter's PV terminals.
meaning.ur: Arc fault module ka self-test fail hua ya inverter ke PV terminals par arc detect hua.

causes.en: An arc occurs on the PV terminals of the inverter.
causes.ur: Inverter ke PV terminals par arc ho raha hai.

solutions.en: If it is the first occurrence, clear the arc fault in the app and restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Agar pehli baar ho to app se arc fault clear karke inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Open the DC isolator and inspect every PV connector and cable for looseness, heat damage or a broken core.
solutions.ur: DC isolator kholein aur har PV connector aur cable ki dhili jagah, garmi ka nuqsan ya toota core check karein.

solutions.en: Unplug and reconnect all DC wiring, replacing any damaged cable, then restart.
solutions.ur: Tamam DC wiring unplug karke dobara lagayein, damaged cable replace karein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: If it still trips, leave the DC isolated and contact after-sales - do not keep re-energising.
solutions.ur: Agar phir bhi trip ho to DC isolate chhor kar after-sales se rabta karein, baar baar on na karein.

source.title: GW EHB User Manual, section 8.1 Error Message

title.ur: GFCI Device Check Failure (EHB) - GFCi kharab

meaning.en: The ground fault current interrupter device inside the inverter failed its self-check.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke andar ka GFCI device apna self-check pass nahi kar saka.

causes.en: External magnetic field disturbing the GFCI self-check.
causes.ur: External magnetic field GFCI self-check ko disturb kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and see whether the fault returns.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke fault wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Move steel structures, motors and transformers away from the unit and its DC cables.
solutions.ur: Steel structures, motors aur transformers ko unit aur DC cables se door karein.

solutions.en: If it returns, contact after-sales - the GFCI device itself has failed.
solutions.ur: Agar wapas aaye to after-sales se rabta karein, khud GFCI device kharab hai.

source.title: GW EHB User Manual, section 8.1 Error Message

title.ur: AC HCT Check Failure (EHB) - sensor kharab

meaning.en: The inverter's AC Hall current sensor self-check failed, indicating a hardware current sensor problem.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke AC Hall current sensor ka self-check fail hua, is ka matlab hardware current sensor mein masla hai.

causes.ur: Inverter ke hardware current sensor kharab hai.

causes.en: Strong external magnetic field around the unit.
causes.ur: Unit ke gird bohat strong external magnetic field.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and confirm whether the code is intermittent or latched.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke code intermittent hai ya latched.

solutions.en: Remove external magnetic sources near the AC cable entry.
solutions.ur: AC cable entry ke paas se magnetic sources hatayein.

solutions.en: If it returns every time, the current sensor has failed - send to after-sales.
solutions.ur: Agar har baar wapas aaye to current sensor kharab hai, after-sales ko bhejein.

source.title: GW EHB User Manual, section 8.1 Error Message

title.ur: PV Over Voltage (EHB) - PV voltage zyada

meaning.en: The open-circuit voltage of a PV string is higher than the inverter's maximum DC input voltage.
meaning.ur: Kisi PV string ka open-circuit voltage inverter ke maximum DC input voltage se zyada hai.

causes.en: PV string Voc higher than the max DC input voltage of the inverter.
causes.ur: PV string ka Voc inverter ke max DC input voltage se zyada hai.

causes.en: Too many modules in series, so Voc rises further in cold conditions.
causes.ur: Series mein modules zyada hain, thande mausam mein Voc aur barh jata hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC isolator and measure each string's Voc with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: DC isolator kholein aur har string ka Voc multimeter se measure karein.

solutions.en: Compare with the max DC input voltage printed on the inverter label.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke label par likhe max DC input voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of series panels until cold-morning Voc is inside the limit.
solutions.ur: Series panels ki sankhya kam karein jab tak thande subah ki Voc limit ke andar na aa jaye.

source.title: GW EHB User Manual, section 8.1 Error Message

meaning.en: Ground insulation impedance of the PV string is too low, tripping the inverter's isolation monitor.
meaning.ur: PV string ka ground insulation impedance bohat kam hai, is liye inverter ka isolation monitor trigger ho gaya.

causes.en: PV string shorted to protective earth.
causes.ur: PV string protective earth se short ho gaya hai.
DC cable ka insulation damaged hai.

causes.en: Heavy humidity in the early morning or after rain.
causes.ur: Subah jaldi ya barsaat ke baad bohat zyada humidity.

solutions.en: Use a multimeter to check resistance between earth and the inverter frame; it should be close to zero.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se earth aur inverter frame ke darmiyan resistance check karein, zero ke qareeb hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Measure resistance from PV1+/PV2+/PV3+/PV4+/BAT+/PV- to earth and compare to the manual's table in 2.4.2.
solutions.ur: PV1+/PV2+/PV3+/PV4+/BAT+/PV- se earth tak resistance measure karke manual ke 2.4.2 table se compare karein.

solutions.en: If below the minimum, disconnect strings one by one and repair the leaking string's connectors.
solutions.ur: Agar minimum se neeche ho to strings aik aik disconnect karke leaking string ke connectors theek karein.

solutions.en: If humidity is genuinely high, log the weather with each event before condemning any part.
solutions.ur: Agar humidity asal mein zyada hai to koi bhi part kharab kehne se pehle har event ke saath weather note karein.

source.title: GW EHB User Manual, section 8.1 Error Message

meaning.en: Relay self-test failed, tied to N and PE not being connected well on the AC side.
meaning.ur: Relay self-test fail hua, is ki wajah AC side par N aur PE ka theek na lagna hai.

causes.en: Neutral and ground cables not connected well on the AC side.
causes.ur: AC side par neutral aur ground cables theek se nahi lage.
Kabhi kabhi relay self-test fail hota hai.

solutions.en: With a multimeter, check for voltage between N and PE on the AC side; normally below 10V.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se AC side par N aur PE ke darmiyan voltage check karein, aam tor par 10V se kam.

solutions.en: If above 10V, re-terminate N and PE at the AC terminal block.
solutions.ur: Agar 10V se zyada ho to AC terminal block par N aur PE dobara terminate karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and confirm the self-test now passes.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karke confirm karein ke self-test ab pass ho gaya.

source.title: GW EHB User Manual, section 8.1 Error Message
